summary:
Rivian虧損收窄且營收續增，產能與成本改善持續，但仍未脫離燒錢階段。
• 營收13.8億美元，年增11.37%，交車與服務營收成長
• EPS虧損0.55美元，略優於預估虧損0.60美元
• 意外幅度8.7%，顯示單車成本與毛利持續改善
• 成本削減與供應鏈優化逐步顯現於損益
ai_view:
訊號偏正面：虧損收窄與營收年增雙雙改善，反映毛利轉正進程與營運效率提升。短期股價可獲超預期支撐，但仍須觀察現金消耗速度與毛利率能否站穩正值。中期關鍵在於R2平台量產時程、單車成本下降幅度與大眾集團合資綜效。建議追蹤交車量、毛利率、自由現金流與資本支出紀律，判斷能否在補貼退場前達到規模經濟。

需留意：仍處虧損且持續燒現金，獲利時點未明；電動車市場競爭加劇、補貼政策不確定性升高；本益比未提供，估值仰賴未來R2平台放量預期

summary_en:
Rivian narrowed its loss with continued revenue growth on improving cost structure, but remains in a cash-burn phase.
• Revenue of $1.38B, up 11.37% YoY on vehicle and service growth
• EPS loss of $0.55, slightly better than the $0.60 estimated loss
• 8.7% surprise indicates ongoing per-unit cost and margin improvement
• Cost cuts and supply-chain optimization gradually showing in results

ai_view_en:
Positive-leaning signal: both loss narrowing and revenue growth improved, reflecting progress toward positive gross margin and better operating efficiency. The beat supports the stock near-term, but watch cash burn and whether gross margin holds positive. Mid-term hinges on R2 platform production timing, per-unit cost declines, and the Volkswagen JV synergies. Track deliveries, gross margin, free cash flow, and capex discipline to gauge reaching scale before subsidies fade.

Watch：Still loss-making and burning cash, with profitability timing unclear; Intensifying EV competition and rising subsidy-policy uncertainty; PE unavailable; valuation relies on future R2 platform volume expectations
beat_or_miss: 超預期：EPS虧損0.55美元優於預估虧損0.60美元，意外幅度8.7%，營收年增11.37%。
